releaseName: v1.4.2 Backup Restore, CSV Import & UI Polish
majorChanges: 🔄 Seamless Backup & Restore: Fixed SQLite WAL/SHM conflicts when importing or exporting backups and added automatic in-app restart after restore or reset
📊 Smarter CSV Import: Improved amount parsing for formatted numbers and automatically matched category icons & colors instead of showing broken placeholders
🗂️ Polished Account Groups: Added crisp borders and a distinct Total footer to Account Type groups on the Home screen
notes: 🏷️ 8 New Default Categories: Added Subscriptions & Mobile, Home & Maintenance, EMI & Loans, Coffee & Snacks, Fitness & Sports, Pets, Charity & Donations, and Freelance & Bonus
✨ Cleaner Home Greeting: Replaced legacy Unicode emojis in the weekly spending banner with modern Material icons
ℹ️ Settings Organization: Moved the About screen to the bottom of Settings

majorChanges: 🔐 Fixed Onboarding Google Sign-In Hang: Resolved a sync completer deadlock that caused Google Sign-In during onboarding to remain stuck on the loading spinner
☁️ Reliable Cloud Sync Lifecycle: Ensured sync operations safely recover from cancellations or errors without locking future syncs
notes: 🧭 Smooth Post-Login Navigation: Onboarding now closes the loading indicator before navigating to the home screen
🛡️ Improved Sign-In Error Handling: Error popups during Google Sign-In now remain visible instead of being dismissed prematurely

majorChanges: 🛡️ Google Play Prominent Disclosures: Clear, sequential in-app disclosures for App Notifications, Notification Listener Access, and Battery Optimization
🔄 Seamless Settings Navigation: Opening Android permission screens now stays inside the app task so pressing Back returns directly to Xpenzi
🟢 Live Device Permission Status: Real-time Active/Off badges in Device Permissions with confirmation dialogs before disabling active permissions
notes: ⌨️ Smooth Nickname Onboarding: Auto-focuses the keyboard when continuing without sign-in and prevents accidental app exit on save or back
👤 Instant Google Account Display: Explore tab and Home greeting immediately reflect your signed-in Google profile name
🔗 Updated Privacy Policy & Web Links: Linked directly to the official Xpenzi Privacy Policy and web portal

majorChanges: 🔒 100% Offline-First & Private: Secure local SQLite database on your device with no data selling
⚡ On-Device SMS & Alert Intelligence: Automatic, private financial SMS and notification parsing running 100% locally
☁️ Google Drive Cloud Backups: One-tap encrypted backup and restore directly with your personal Google Drive
✨ Ask AI Financial Assistant: Conversational natural language search to query spending and trends instantly
notes: 🎯 Visual Category Budgets: Set monthly spending limits with real-time progress indicators
📈 Interactive Net Worth & Cash-Flow Charts: Track monthly trends and balances with clean charts
💳 Multi-Wallet & Multi-Currency: Manage bank accounts, cash, and credit cards with exchange rates
⏰ Recurring Transactions: Scheduled budgets and bill payment reminders across device reboots
🔐 Biometric App Lock: Protect your financial records with Fingerprint & Face Unlock
📤 Data Export & Portability: Full control to export your data anytime to CSV or JSON
